themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that perform tasks and make decisions autonomously within research contexts, including coding, data analysis, and workflow automation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, auditing, and understanding code, including vulnerability detection and code generation.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: This theme covers AI platforms and tools specifically designed to analyze customer data and provide actionable insights for engagement and product development.

themes.name: AI for design research
themes.description: Articles exploring the use of AI in the design process, from generating design elements to evaluating design strategy and branding.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: This theme encompasses AI tools and platforms designed to facilitate various aspects of the research process, including data collection and analysis.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content related to the creation and use of artificial users for AI testing and development, particularly in regulated environments.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's ability to condense large amounts of information into concise summaries, particularly for insights and analysis.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Discussions on the ethical considerations, biases, and potential harms associated with the application of AI in research and product development.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that review, benchmark, and compare different AI tools and models for specific applications like coding, analytics, and voice assistants.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: This theme covers the impact of AI on jobs, required skills, and the changing roles within the workforce, particularly in tech and research.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
